# Cádiz Music Stadium 2027 Starts with El Barrio and Antoñito Molina


by[Press](https://nomadar.com/author/press/)


| Oct 27, 2026


|[News](https://nomadar.com/category/news/) |[0 comments](https://nomadar.com/cadiz-music-stadium-2027-starts-with-el-barrio-and-antonito-molina/#respond)


Cádiz Music Stadium has announced its first two artists for its third edition. El Barrio will perform on July 10, 2027, and Antoñito Molina will perform on July 3, 2027, both at Nuevo Mirandilla, the home of Cádiz CF. Two artists from the province of Cádiz are kicking off a summer full of great concerts.


José Luis Figuereo, known as El Barrio, is bringing his “30” tour to celebrate three decades on stage. With more than three million records sold, 14 studio albums, six gold records, 15 platinum records and more than 600 concerts, he will look back on his career and play new songs, including “Peliculón,” the first single from his upcoming album.


Antoñito Molina, who is from Rota, returns to a stadium that is very special to him and that he sold out at his first concert in 2025. He comes at a great moment in his career, with his Destino Felicidad tour and new songs such as “Ya no me acuerdo de ti.” This week, he is also presenting a documentary at the South Festival about that first concert at Nuevo Mirandilla.


In the 2025 edition, international artists such as Jennifer López and Il Divo took the stage, along with Manuel Carrasco, Antoñito Molina and the Carnaval Mágico. In 2026, it was the turn of Leiva, Los Delinqüentes, La Flamenca and La Reina del Flow, as well as Aitana, who started her world tour in Cádiz.


Now, 2027 starts with a great lineup, and in its third year the festival is becoming well established as part of Nomadar’s model for managing event spaces. Stay tuned for more announcements and, in the meantime,[you can get El Barrio tickets here](https://eternidadeventos.com/eventos/el-barrio-cadiz-2027/) .
